issues.description: The problem statement and solution use the function name build_msd_circ, but the template defines build_msd_circuit (different name). This name mismatch is structural: students following the template may implement or call the template-named function while tests and the provided solution expect the other name, leading to confusion and failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the template's build_msd_circuit to build_msd_circ (or vice versa) so that the template, problem statement, and tests all reference the same function name. Update any internal calls and documentation accordingly.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution use the function name build_msd_circ(...) for constructing the distillation circuit, while the template defines a function named build_msd_circuit(...). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual entity (the 15-to-1 MSD circuit builder) will confuse students and break automated tests that expect the name from the problem statement/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the template function build_msd_circuit(...) to build_msd_circ(...) so it matches the problem statement/tests and the solution, or alternatively update the problem/tests and solution to use build_msd_circuit(...). Ensure the chosen name is used everywhere (problem_statement.md, msd.py template, and msd.py solution).
